unlinkedHead.one: {n} file in this folder isn’t matched to an issue
unlinkedHead.other: {n} files in this folder aren’t matched to an issue

unlinkedNote: They count as missing until they match. The issue number is read from the file’s ComicInfo tag first, then its filename, and looked up in this series’ issue list — if the match is the wrong series, use Fix match; if the number is, retag or rename the file, then Scan folder{assign}.
unlinkedAssign: — or just assign the file to its issue here; the assignment is remembered through rescans

unlinkedBeyond.one: {n} of them has a number this series never reaches (it has {issues}) — this is almost certainly the wrong match. Fix match to the right one and the files link on their own.
unlinkedBeyond.other: {n} of them have numbers this series never reaches (it has {issues}) — this is almost certainly the wrong match. Fix match to the right one and the files link on their own.

unlinkedAbsent.one: {n} of them has a number this series doesn’t list. A retitled run is often split into two series (the early issues under the old title), so that issue may belong to a sibling series — add it as its own series. If the list just looks out of date, Refresh metadata re-reads the series.
unlinkedAbsent.other: {n} of them have numbers this series doesn’t list. A retitled run is often split into two series (the early issues under the old title), so those issues may belong to a sibling series — add it as its own series. If the list just looks out of date, Refresh metadata re-reads the series.
